name: discover-tridentum
description: Discover Tridentum — la guida che racconta la Trento che non trovi su Google

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n backend,frontend -c red,blue "npm run dev -w versione-corrente/backend" "npm run dev -w versione-corrente/frontend"
scripts.dev:v1: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n backend,frontend-v1 -c red,magenta "npm run dev -w versione-corrente/backend" "npm --prefix versioni-precedenti/frontend-v1 run dev"
scripts.dev:v2: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n backend,frontend-v2 -c red,magenta "npm run dev -w versione-corrente/backend" "npm --prefix versioni-precedenti/frontend-v2 run dev"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm start -w versione-corrente/backend
scripts.test: npm test -w versione-corrente/frontend && npm test -w versione-corrente/backend
